caption: The count field is a scalar result of 3.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['jsonpath-vault-query']; const v=await p.openView(); p.pro.signOut();v.path='Local JSON Queries/people.json';v.expression='count';v.draw();await v.run();return 'ok';})()

caption: People appear as a table with renamed columns.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['jsonpath-vault-query']; const v=await p.openView(); v.path='Local JSON Queries/people.json';v.expression='rows[*].{person:name,years:age,team:team,hours:hours}';v.draw();await v.run();return 'ok';})()

caption: A JSONL file gives an array of names.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['jsonpath-vault-query']; const v=await p.openView(); v.path='Local JSON Queries/names.jsonl';v.expression='[*].name';v.draw();await v.run();return 'ok';})()

caption: The saved Adults pair restores the file and expression.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['jsonpath-vault-query']; const v=await p.openView(); await p.saveQuery({name:'Adults',path:'Local JSON Queries/people.json',expression:'rows[?age > `25`].{person:name,years:age}'});v.selectSaved('Adults');await v.run();return 'ok';})()

caption: A saved query combines two chosen local files.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['jsonpath-vault-query']; const v=await p.openView(); p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}});app.secretStorage.setSecret('jsonpath-vault-query-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36));await p.pro.refreshNow();await p.saveQuery({name:'Team hours',path:'Local JSON Queries/people.json',expression:'rows[*].{person:name,team:team,hours:hours}'});v.selectSaved('Team hours');v.batchPaths='Local JSON Queries/people.json\nLocal JSON Queries/second.json';v.draw();await v.run(true);return 'ok';})()
